verdict.rationale: Cloud Agents run in isolated VMs with "full development environments" and can build, test, and start dev servers. The Cloud Agents API accepts session-scoped encrypted envVars, inline MCP servers, and routing to Cursor-hosted VMs or your own pools. Self-Hosted Machines let you run agent tools on a machine you manage, and `.cursor/worktrees.json` setup scripts give reproducible dependency setup, but only for local worktrees, not cloud VMs. Missing for 10: a documented, version-controlled environment definition for cloud agents (base image/Dockerfile, install and setup commands, snapshots), evidence that cloud setup is reproducible across runs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
